title: a foreign tagged template invokes the tag function, so it needs the same contract a foreign call needs
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, "Foreign Boundary": "Calling an unannotated foreign runtime value MUST add the checked `panic` case, because JavaScript and TypeScript may throw, reject, or violate a declaration." A tagged template is a *call*, not a coercion, so it lands on `SMITHERS1504` — poc/src/language/README.md: 'a call-like foreign form whose Result lowering is deferred is not accepted unless its resolved signature declares `@throws {never}`', and it names the tagged template as one of the three spellings that reach it beside `new Foreign(...)`. The tag never appears in call position, which is why it escaped a rule keyed on call expressions.
